props.description: Show the "open in panel" button (it also needs MarkdownHost `onOpenPreview`).

props.name: enablePanZoom
props.description:
Drag-to-pan and zoom buttons over the diagram. The wheel is left to the page, so scrolling
a long document past a diagram never zooms it.

props.name: isMaximized
props.description: Current window state; switches the middle button between Maximize and Restore.

props.name: onToggleMaximize
props.description: Maximize when restored, restore when maximized.
